title: Daily health metric
description: A normalized health or recovery value aggregated for one local date.

localDate.description: The local calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

confidence.description: The normalized confidence score from zero to one.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone used to assign the observation to its local date.

sourceBreakdown.description: The privacy-reviewed provider candidates and selection evidence used to produce this canonical value.

recordedAt.description: The representative observation time in ISO 8601 format.

source.description: The system or user action that originally supplied this record.

sourceExternalId.description: The stable record identifier assigned by the source system, when available.

sourceUpdatedAt.description: The last modification time reported by the source system in ISO 8601 format.
